## Fully Comprehensive Findings

### Section 1: JPMorgan Chase & Co.

JPMorgan Chase & Co., one of the world's largest financial institutions ($4.425 trillion in assets, $57B net income, $182.4B revenue in 2025), has invested heavily in AI with an annual technology budget exceeding $18 billion. The bank ranks at the top of the Evident AI Index for AI maturity in banking, with over 450 AI use cases in production and plans to expand to 1,000 by 2026. The firm's technology budget reached $17 billion in 2024, with approximately $1.3 billion dedicated specifically to advancing AI capabilities and another $3.1 billion for modernizing cloud infrastructure and data platforms. JPMC has assembled over 2,000 AI/ML specialists and targets $1.5-2 billion in annual business value from AI. [1][4][5][29]

#### 1A. IndexGPT (Client-Facing Thematic Investment Baskets)

- **Product Name:** IndexGPT
- **Launch Month:** May 2024 (announced May 3, 2024, following a trademark filing in May 2023)
- **Product Type:** Client-facing AI-powered thematic investment basket creation tool
- **Customer Tier:** Available to J.P. Morgan's institutional and wealth management clients
- **Geography/Languages:** Global (launched by J.P. Morgan Asset Management); available in English initially
- **Core AI Stack:** OpenAI's GPT-4 model for keyword generation, combined with a proprietary Natural Language Processing (NLP) model that scans news articles to identify companies involved in a given theme
- **Description:** IndexGPT creates thematic investment baskets by generating a list of keywords associated with a particular theme. These keywords are then analyzed using a natural language processing model that scans news articles to identify companies involved in that space. Unlike traditional indexes based on industry sectors or company fundamentals, IndexGPT identifies investments based on emerging trends using AI-generated keywords extracted from news articles. The tool allows for the selection of a broader range of stocks, going beyond the obvious choices that are already well-known.
- **Safety & Compliance:** Built within JPMorgan's controlled environment; proprietary data is not used to train the model. The bank has protocols restricting employees from using consumer AI chatbots, and IndexGPT was developed internally with the bank's data security protocols.
- **Integrations:** Part of J.P. Morgan's broader index offering; integrates with the bank's existing investment platforms
- **Access/Pricing:** Available to J.P. Morgan clients; specific pricing not publicly disclosed
- **KPIs:** According to Rui Fernandes, J.P. Morgan's head of markets trading structuring, IndexGPT is seen as "a first step in a long-term process of integrating AI across the bank's index offering." Thematic investing gained popularity in 2020-2021 but waned due to poor performance and higher interest rates; IndexGPT aims to reignite interest by providing a more accurate approach.
- **Executive Quote:** "IndexGPT creates these thematic indexes by generating a list of keywords associated with a particular theme that are then analyzed using a natural language processing model that scans news articles to identify companies involved in that space" — Rui Fernandes, J.P. Morgan's head of markets trading structuring. [2][3][4][6][7][29]

#### 1B. Connect Coach (Wealth Advisor Copilot)

- **Product Name:** Connect Coach (also referred to as "Coach AI")
- **Launch Month:** In production by early 2025; recognized by Euromoney award on March 28, 2025
- **Product Type:** AI-powered advisor copilot embedded in JPMorgan's Connect platform for wealth management advisors
- **Customer Tier:** Wealth management advisors serving high-net-worth clients (JPMorgan Private Bank)
- **Geography/Languages:** North America initially; English
- **Core AI Stack:** Multiple AI agents and large language models (LLMs) integrated; uses NLP and predictive AI
- **Description:** An advanced AI-powered co-pilot embedded in the firm's Connect platform, which integrates multiple AI agents and large language models (LLMs) to enhance adviser capabilities. It allows 95% faster information retrieval, contributed to 20% YoY gross sales growth, and enables advisors to potentially expand client rosters by 50%.
- **Safety & Compliance:** Built within JPMorgan's secure, proprietary environment with data protection controls
- **Integrations:** Embedded in JPMorgan's Connect platform (the private bank's core advisory platform)
- **Access/Pricing:** Available to JPMorgan Private Bank advisors; specific pricing not publicly disclosed
- **KPIs:** 
  - 95% faster information retrieval for advisors
  - 20% year-over-year gross sales growth attributed to the tool
  - Advisors expected to grow their client base by 50% over the next three to five years, driven by these gains in speed and efficiency
  - During recent market turmoil, the AI tools helped teams scale service without sacrificing quality
- **Executive Quote:** "AI isn't just helping banks work faster, it's helping them show up better for clients in moments of volatility" — Michael Abbott (Global Banking Lead at Accenture, referencing Mary Callahan Erdoes). "It's about giving our people the ability to make stronger, faster and smarter decisions" — head of the investment platform on the Spectrum tool. [29][30][31]

#### 1C. SpectrumGPT (Portfolio Manager Nudge Engine)

- **Product Name:** Spectrum (also referred to as SpectrumGPT)
- **Launch Month:** In production by 2024
- **Product Type:** Internal investing platform with embedded LLMs that sends "nudge" alerts to portfolio managers
- **Customer Tier:** Internal J.P. Morgan Asset Management portfolio managers
- **Geography/Languages:** Global
- **Core AI Stack:** Large language models (LLMs) embedded in the platform
- **Description:** An internal investing platform with embedded LLMs that sends "nudge" alerts to portfolio managers about holding periods and reduces research time by up to 83%. It is a task-specific AI chatbot for the asset and wealth management segment.
- **Safety & Compliance:** Internal-use only; built with JPMorgan's data security protocols
- **Integrations:** Integrated with J.P. Morgan Asset Management's investment platforms
- **Access/Pricing:** Internal use only by J.P. Morgan Asset Management portfolio managers
- **KPIs:** Reduces research time by up to 83% [4][29][32]

#### 1D. LLM Suite (Employee Productivity Platform — Note: Included as supporting infrastructure)

- **Product Name:** LLM Suite
- **Launch Month:** Summer 2024 (initial rollout); expanded through 2025-2026
- **Product Type:** Proprietary, model-agnostic generative AI platform (internal employee productivity tool, not client-facing but used to support client-facing roles)
- **Customer Tier:** Internal employees — 250,000 employees have access (entire workforce except branch and call center staff), with half using it daily
- **Core AI Stack:** Multi-model — integrates LLMs from OpenAI (GPT-4) and Anthropic (Claude) with the bank's internal databases; model-agnostic architecture
- **Description:** A portal that harnesses large language models from OpenAI and Anthropic. It supports idea generation, content drafting, and workflow automation. An investment banker can generate a presentation deck in ~30 seconds that previously took hours. Over 200,000 employees onboarded within 8 months. LLM Suite is updated every eight weeks, receiving more data and capabilities from the bank's major businesses.
- **Safety & Compliance:** Designed as a "controlled portal to external models" to protect proprietary data. "Since our data is a key differentiator, we don't want it being used to train the model" — Teresa Heitsenrether, Chief Data & Analytics Officer. The bank initially banned external tools like ChatGPT and built LLM Suite as a secure alternative.
- **KPIs:** Employees report 30-40% efficiency gains; the bank estimates up to $1.5 billion in annual value from AI initiatives. Engineering teams saw 10-20% efficiency gains from AI coding assistants. [1][4][5][29]

- **LOXM** — AI program for optimizing trade execution in global equities, improving execution efficiency by approximately 15% based on lessons from billions of past trades [4]
- **OmniAI** — Enterprise-wide ML platform for standardizing AI/ML deployment across all business lines, including fraud detection. Won the CIO 100 Technology Award and was named Most Cutting-Edge IT Initiative at Waters Technology's AFTAs. [1][4]
- **DocLLM** — Proprietary, layout-aware generative language model that outperforms GPT-4 with OCR on 14/16 document intelligence benchmarks [29]
- **EVEE Intelligent Q&A** — GenAI assistant for call center agents [29]
- **AI-Powered Fraud & AML Systems** — Real-time ML models preventing $1.5 billion in losses with 98% accuracy, plus 95% reduction in AML false positives [29]

### Section 2: Goldman Sachs

Goldman Sachs has invested heavily in AI, with CEO David Solomon stating on the company's Q1 earnings call that the firm is "leveraging AI solutions to scale and transform our engineering capabilities" and expressed belief that AI adoption will drive productivity gains and efficiencies for both Goldman Sachs and the broader economy. [8][9][10][11][12][13][14][15][23][24][25][26][27][28]

#### 2A. GS AI Assistant (Firmwide AI Assistant)

- **Product Name:** GS AI Assistant (also referred to as "Goldman Sachs AI Assistant" or "Banker Copilot")
- **Launch Month:** Initial rollout to ~10,000 employees in January 2025; firmwide launch announced June 23, 2025
- **Product Type:** Firmwide generative AI assistant for employees — supports investment banking, research, asset and wealth management, and development tasks. Used for summarizing complex documents, drafting initial content, and performing data analysis.
- **Customer Tier:** All Goldman Sachs employees (~46,500 globally). Initially deployed to 10,000 employees (traders, bankers, asset managers), then expanded to all knowledge workers firmwide by June 2025.
- **Geography/Languages:** Global; includes translation functionality for client-facing documents
- **Core AI Stack:** Multi-model architecture — supports OpenAI's GPT-4o, Google's Gemini models, Meta's Llama, and Claude 3.7 Sonnet. Users can select the model best suited to their needs. The firm is also considering models from Anthropic, Mistral, and Cohere.
- **Description:** The GS AI Assistant helps employees with tasks such as summarizing complex documents, drafting initial content, and performing data analysis. It can interact with different large language models, enabling users to select the one that best meets their needs, and has features tailored to different work functions like developers, investment bankers, research analysts, and asset and wealth management employees. CIO Marco Argenti described it as "the first generative AI-powered tool to reach this scale" at the firm. Argenti envisions the AI evolving over three to five years to exhibit "agentic behavior" — performing multistep tasks autonomously — and eventually reasoning like an experienced Goldman employee. He likened the AI to a new employee that will absorb Goldman's culture, values, and way of thinking over time.
- **Safety & Compliance:** Goldman Sachs employs a "human-in-the-loop" model; the AI assistant is designed to produce answers based on bank data fed into AI models. The firm has rigorous evaluation frameworks and bias mitigation protocols. The tool is designed to "empower employees by reducing the time spent on repetitive tasks" and "act as a force multiplier."
- **Integrations:** Integrated with Goldman Sachs' internal systems and data repositories; supports multiple LLM providers
- **Access/Pricing:** Internal tool for Goldman Sachs employees; not client-facing
- **KPIs:**
  - CEO David Solomon publicly demonstrated AI completing 95% of an IPO prospectus (S1 filing) in minutes, compared with two weeks for a six-person human team
  - Thousands of employees using the tool for daily tasks before firmwide launch
  - Bloomberg Intelligence estimates global investment banks may cut up to 200,000 jobs over 3-5 years due to AI, particularly in back and middle office roles
  - 72% of finance leaders are actively using AI in their operations (PYMNTS Intelligence)
  - Nearly all banking boards have approved generative AI initiatives
- **Executive Quotes:**
  - "The AI assistant becomes really like talking to another GS employee" — Marco Argenti, CIO
  - "Think about all the tasks that you might want to complete with regards to a variety of use cases for all those professions that can be now at your fingertips" — Marco Argenti

  - "Today marks an important moment in our AI journey as we are excited to announce the firmwide launch of the GS AI Assistant – the first generative AI-powered tool to reach this scale" — Marco Argenti, internal memo, June 23, 2025
  - "We continue to believe an acceleration in AI adoption will allow for further efficiencies for our own business, and for companies large and small. As it is utilized more broadly, productivity gains for the economy will be significant" — David Solomon, CEO [8][9][10][11][12][13][14][15][23][24][25][26][27][28]

#### 2B. Additional Context: AI in Financial Planning (External)

- An Instagram post from @getintoai (March 9, 2026) discusses how AI can now generate "Goldman Sachs–style financial plans in minutes," noting that AI can structure full financial reports covering budgeting, investing, debt payoff, tax strategies, retirement projections, insurance reviews, and real estate analysis—tasks that previously required a team of specialists. The post notes that "Tools that once existed only inside banks and advisory firms are becoming available to anyone willing to learn how to use them." [15]

### Section 3: Morgan Stanley

Morgan Stanley has deployed AI from OpenAI to transform its wealth management services, enhancing its financial advisors' ability to access and utilize the firm's vast knowledge base. The firm's AI push contributed to nearly $64 billion in net new assets in Q4 2024 alone. The firm projects ~$3 trillion in AI infrastructure investments by 2028. [16][17][18][19][20][21][22][33][34][35][36][37]

#### 3A. AI @ Morgan Stanley Assistant (Financial Advisor Copilot)

- **Product Name:** AI @ Morgan Stanley Assistant (also referred to as "Morgan Stanley Assistant" or "AI @ Morgan Stanley")
- **Launch Month:** Announced in collaboration with OpenAI in early 2023; rolled out in September 2023 to financial advisors
- **Product Type:** AI-powered assistant for financial advisors to access, analyze, and synthesize Morgan Stanley's extensive intellectual capital

# Cleaned Research Findings: Canadian Banks' AI Portfolio-Management & Financial-Planning Copilots (2023–2026)

---

## List of Queries and Tool Calls Made

The following searches were conducted to gather information:

1. **Broad search:** "Canadian bank AI portfolio management copilot 2024 2025"
2. **RBC search:** "RBC Royal Bank AI financial planning assistant copilot launch 2024"
3. **TD Bank search:** "TD Bank AI portfolio management advisor copilot 2024 2025"
4. **BMO search:** "BMO AI financial planning portfolio management copilot 2024 2025"
5. **Scotiabank search:** "Scotiabank AI portfolio advisor copilot 2024 2025"
6. **CIBC search:** "CIBC AI financial planning assistant copilot 2024 2025"
7. **National Bank of Canada search:** "National Bank of Canada AI advisor wealth management copilot"
8. **Desjardins search:** "Desjardins AI portfolio management financial planning copilot"

---

## Fully Comprehensive Findings

### 1. RBC Royal Bank

**NOMI (AI-powered personal finance suite)**
- **Launch:** NOMI was launched in 2017 (pre-dates the 2023–2026 timeframe for *new* launches, but the suite has been continuously expanded during the 2023–2026 period with new features).
- **Description:** RBC launched AI-powered personal finance services called NOMI (a play on "know me"), powered by Personetics Cognitive Banking applications. These services are built directly into RBC's existing mobile app, giving all RBC customers access. [6]
- **Features:**
  - **NOMI Insights:** Provides personalized, timely tips to help customers manage day-to-day finances. It offers daily insights into spending patterns, identifies unusual transactions, issues automatic reminders based on past activity, and predicts potential issues. Unlike US bank alerts which require manual setup, RBC's alerts are generated automatically. The system learns as it interacts with users, becoming more accurate over time. Over 2 billion insights delivered since 2017. [8]
  - **NOMI Find & Save:** An automated savings program. Based on predictive analysis of individual behavior and spending patterns, it determines the minimum cash needed in checking for monthly expenses and automatically transfers excess cash to an interest-bearing savings account. The auto-save can be suspended at any time, and money can be moved back to checking. Customers have saved over $1.9 billion (average $415/month or ~$5,000/year). [8]
  - **NOMI Budget:** Suggests customized budgets based on spending habits; over 2 million budgets suggested since 2019. [8]
  - **NOMI Forecast** (newest addition): Uses ML/AI to provide 7-day cash-flow forecasts based on preauthorized payment withdrawals, helping customers avoid overdrafts and manage short-term finances. Uses technology from Borealis AI, RBC's research center. [8]
  - **Ask NOMI:** Multilingual chatbot that has responded to 4 million text and voice inquiries. [8]
- **Customer tier:** All RBC personal banking customers (mass market). NOMI now serves 12.8 million personal banking customers and has about 1.5 million active users. [8]
- **Geography/Languages:** Canada, multilingual (Ask NOMI supports multiple languages). [8]
- **Core AI stack:** Powered by Personetics Cognitive Banking applications; NOMI Forecast uses technology from Borealis AI (RBC's research center). [8] RBC also developed a proprietary AI foundation model for financial services called **ATOM**, trained on asynchronous event sequences (transactions, client interactions) to enable personalized banking solutions. [7]
- **Safety & Compliance:** RBC's Responsible AI principles: Privacy & Security, Accountability, Fairness, and Transparency & Responsible Disclosure. [10]
- **Integrations:** Built into RBC's existing mobile app. [6]
- **Access/Pricing:** Available to all RBC customers within the mobile app; no additional cost. [6]
- **KPIs:**
  - 53% of NOMI users say it's a game changer for their finances. [8]
  - Customer attrition among NOMI users is less than 1%. [8]
  - Average visit time on the RBC mobile app has more than doubled from 3.5 minutes to 7.5 minutes since NOMI launched. [8]
  - One in nine Canadians had access to NOMI features on their phones within weeks of launch. [6]
  - RBC ranks #1 in Canada and #3 globally for AI maturity in financial services (fourth straight year, per Evident AI Index). [7]

**RBC Borealis (AI research & platform team)**
- RBC Borealis is RBC's AI research and data platform team, comprising architects, engineers, scientists, and product experts focused on revolutionizing finance through AI research, solutions, and a resilient data platform. [7]
- **Lumina:** RBC's internal enterprise data and AI platform for engineers, data scientists, and business analysts. [7]
- **RESPECT AI™:** A responsible AI platform providing knowledge, algorithms, and tooling for ethical AI development. [7]
- **Partnership with Cohere:** RBC has partnered with Cohere to develop secure generative AI solutions for financial services, including an AI agent-builder system for bank employees. [7]
- RBC and RBC Borealis are members of FinTechAI@CSAIL at MIT. [7]

**Aiden (AI electronic trading platform)**
- A first for the industry, Aiden is a revolutionary AI electronic trading platform using deep reinforcement learning and advanced AI algorithms to learn and adapt to changing market conditions in real time. [10]
- **Note:** This is a capital markets tool, not a client-facing portfolio-management copilot for retail/wealth management clients.

**Digital Government Identity Verification**
- RBC is the first Canadian bank to introduce digital government identity verification solutions using AI-enabled technology, providing clients with more secure identity verification, stronger fraud protection and a faster account opening experience. [10]

**Key NOMI Quote from Peter Tilton, SVP Digital at RBC:** "By providing customers with insights and helping them with financial management, the platform helps us achieve our goal to democratize finance for consumers, regardless of how much money they have or how financially literate they are." [8]

---

### 2. TD Bank

**TD Generative AI Pilots (May 2024)**
- **Launch:** Announced May 16, 2024. Two generative AI pilots were announced:
  1. A generative AI virtual assistant developed by TD's AI research centre, **Layer 6**, to help contact centre colleagues quickly retrieve answers to banking inquiries, reducing hold times. [11]
  2. **GitHub Copilot**, a generative AI programming assistant from Microsoft, to help engineers accelerate code development. [11]
- **Status:** Both were pilots (not production). A pilot test between September and December 2023 found that 50% of engineers surveyed said GitHub Copilot could save up to 20 hours over a two-week sprint, and 93% of data engineers reported being equally or more productive. [11]
- **Note:** These are employee-facing tools, not client-facing portfolio-management or financial-planning copilots. The virtual assistant is for contact centre colleagues, not clients directly.

**TD AI Insights Report (2025)**
- TD Bank's inaugural 2025 AI Insights Report revealed that the majority of Americans are ready to embrace AI to help manage their money, but there are still concerns around more personal aspects of finances. [14]

**TD AI Capabilities in 2024 Annual Report**
- **AI models for instant mortgage/HELOC pre-approvals** [15]
- A machine learning model in TD Insurance for instant term life insurance approvals [15]
- **Gen AI virtual assistant for its Canadian Contact Centre** to improve response times [15]
- **GitHub Copilot** introduced to streamline coding for engineers [15]
- TD completed its large-scale migration of the enterprise on-premises data platform to the cloud. [15]
- TD is the #1 Canadian financial institution patent filer and is amongst the top three patent filers across all Canadian companies. The Bank's patents portfolio reached over 2,500 patent assets, of which over 800 are for Artificial Intelligence (AI). [15]
- In 2024, 22 patents filed were inventions related to Trustworthy AI, helping TD ensure that its AI models align with the Bank's values while enhancing the customer experience and mitigating risk. [15]
- Ranked Top 10 Globally in the 2024 Evident AI Index, an independent benchmark for AI adoption and performance in the financial services sector. [15]
- Named Best Consumer Digital Bank in North America for the 4th consecutive year by Global Finance. [15]

**TD Wealth**
- TD Wealth launched the **TD Digital Vault** for secure document sharing. [15]
- **No client-facing AI portfolio-management copilot was found in production (2023–2026)** for TD.

---

### 3. BMO Bank of Montreal

**No client-facing AI portfolio-management or financial-planning copilot found in production (2023–2026).**

**Relevant Context:**
- BMO Nesbitt Burns published an Investment Strategy - February 2025 discussing DeepSeek's impact on AI investment dynamics. [1]
- A BMO survey found 37% of Americans use AI to manage finances. [2]
- BMO economists expect the overnight rate could drop to 1.50% if tariffs are fully imposed. [1]
- **No evidence of a launched client-facing AI portfolio-management copilot was found for BMO.**

---

### 4. Scotiabank

**Scotia Intelligence (March 2026)**
- **Launch:** Scotia Intelligence, Scotiabank's unified data and AI platform, launched in March 2026. [9]
- **Description:** Scotiabank announced the expansion of its enterprise AI resources with new knowledge agents available through Scotia Intelligence. The new agents — Delivery Navigator, Travel and Expense Knowledge Agent, and Procurement Knowledge Agent — are designed to help employees access institutional information, navigate internal processes, and focus on higher-value client-facing work. [9]
- **Usage stats:** Since Scotia Intelligence launched in March 2026, over 71,000 employees have generated 14 million actions. More than 80% of the global workforce and over 90% of directors and above have completed at least one AI training course. [9]
- **Note:** This is an employee-facing platform, not a client-facing portfolio-management copilot.

**Scotiabank AI Agents for Payment Operations (2025)**
- Scotiabank's Global Transaction Banking division is using AI agents to transform payment operations. The bank partnered with EY and Microsoft to prototype a system of five specialized AI agents built on Microsoft's Copilot platform in under three months. These agents automate data transformation, financial reconciliation, and report generation for the Client Insight Report—a service that previously took weeks and was only available to select clients, now completed in seconds and scalable to all clients. [8] (Source 8 in the Global Transaction Banking search - GTB Scotiabank)
- **Note:** This is a transaction banking tool, not a client-facing portfolio-management copilot.

**Scotiabank Investor Sentiment Survey (Fall 2025)**
- According to a survey conducted by Scotiabank in Fall 2025, some investors using AI tools view it as complementary to the information and guidance from their primary financial advisor (30%), but the majority (62%) trust their financial advisor more than AI-generated advice. [6] (Source 6 in the Scotiabank search - Enriched Thinking)
- Male investors were more likely to have consulted AI tools about finances and investments in the past year and those aged 45+ were less likely. [6] (Source 6 in the Scotiabank search)
- The Scotia Global Asset Management Investor Sentiment survey was conducted by Environics Research from October 28-November 6, 2025. The online survey included 1,045 Canadians, 25 years of age or older with household investable assets of $25,000 or more and who participate in investments decisions for their household. [6] (Source 6 in the Scotiabank search)

**Scotiabank GBM AI Research**
- Scotiabank Global Banking and Markets (GBM) has a "Focus On AI" series produced by their Equity Research team, aiming to demystify AI for investors, corporations, and policymakers through reports and webcasts with industry experts. [7] (Source 7 in the Scotiabank search)
- AI adoption is driving a clear divide between leaders and laggards among small and mid-cap Internet companies. [7] (Source 7 in the Scotiabank search)
- **No client-facing AI portfolio-management copilot was found in production (2023–2026) for Scotiabank.**

---

### 5. CIBC

**CIBC AdvisorAssist (July 2026)**
- **Launch:** Announced July 31, 2026, with national launch. [10, 11] (Sources 10 and 11 in the CIBC search)
- **Description:** CIBC announced the national launch of CIBC AdvisorAssist, a proprietary AI-powered platform designed to help advisors spend less time on administrative work and more time with clients. The tool uses generative AI to automatically capture and summarize notes during client meetings and streamline follow-up documentation, potentially reducing administrative tasks by up to 50%. [10, 11] (Sources 10 and 11 in the CIBC search)
- **Coverage:** Developed internally by CIBC, the platform spans Personal Banking, Imperial Service, and Wealth Management, and was built with input from advisors, regulatory supervision, technology, and compliance teams. [10, 11] (Sources 10 and 11 in the CIBC search)
- **Key quote:** "This tool was built in direct response to feedback from our advisors and with a goal of helping them be more present for our clients, and reflects our deep commitment to innovation," said Ed Dodig, Executive Vice-President, Personal Banking and Imperial Service, CIBC. [10, 11] (Sources 10 and 11 in the CIBC search)
- **Key quote:** "At CIBC, we see AI as an enabler of who we already are: a relationship-driven, client-focused bank," said Jaime Tatis, Executive Vice-President, Chief Data & Artificial Intelligence Officer, CIBC. [10, 11] (Sources 10 and 11 in the CIBC search)
- **Note:** This is an advisor-facing administrative tool, not explicitly positioned as a client-facing portfolio-management or financial-planning copilot. However, it is part of CIBC's broader AI suite for wealth management.

**CIBC CRTeX (2025)**
- **Launch:** 2025. [10, 11] (Sources 10 and 11 in the CIBC search)
- **Description:** Provides real-time client insights and next-best-action suggestions. [10, 11] (Sources 10 and 11 in the CIBC search)
- **Note:** This is more of a client-facing tool providing insights, but it's unclear if it's a copilot/assistant directly used by clients or by advisors on behalf of clients.

**CIBC DocuMind (2025)**
- **Launch:** 2025. [10, 11] (Sources 10 and 11 in the CIBC search)
- **Description:** An enterprise document intelligence platform that processes 63,000 documents monthly, saving 16,000 hours per quarter. [10, 11] (Sources 10 and 11 in the CIBC search)

**CIBC Voice Assistant (2025)**
- **Launch:** 2025. [10, 11] (Sources 10 and 11 in the CIBC search)
- **Description:** Has handled over 16 million calls since launch, resolving straightforward inquiries quickly. [10, 11] (Sources 10 and 11 in the CIBC search)

**CIBC AI Transformation (Microsoft partnership)**
- CIBC's AI transformation journey uses Microsoft Azure, GitHub Copilot, and Microsoft Purview. [12] (Source 12 in the CIBC search)
- **Education-first strategy:** CIBC began with hands-on AI immersions for board and senior leaders, expanded to executives, then to the entire organization. Teams completed over 37,000 training courses. [12] (Source 12 in the CIBC search)
- **Security and governance:** The bank strengthened its architecture using Azure for secure cloud infrastructure and Microsoft Purview for data governance. Most of CIBC's consumable data now lives in Azure. [12] (Source 12 in the CIBC search)
- **Developer productivity:** More than 1,700 developers use GitHub Copilot to handle repetitive tasks like boilerplate code and testing, allowing them to focus on higher-value work. [12] (Source 12 in the CIBC search)

## Fully Comprehensive Findings

### Section 1: JPMorgan Chase & Co.

JPMorgan Chase & Co., one of the world's largest financial institutions ($4.425 trillion in assets, $57B net income, $182.4B revenue in 2025), has invested heavily in AI with an annual technology budget exceeding $18 billion. The bank ranks at the top of the Evident AI Index for AI maturity in banking, with over 450 AI use cases in production and plans to expand to 1,000 by 2026. The firm's technology budget reached $17 billion in 2024, with approximately $1.3 billion dedicated specifically to advancing AI capabilities and another $3.1 billion for modernizing cloud infrastructure and data platforms. JPMC has assembled over 2,000 AI/ML specialists and targets $1.5-2 billion in annual business value from AI. [1][4][5][29]

#### 1A. IndexGPT (Client-Facing Thematic Investment Baskets)

- **Product Name:** IndexGPT
- **Launch Month:** May 2024 (announced May 3, 2024, following a trademark filing in May 2023)
- **Product Type:** Client-facing AI-powered thematic investment basket creation tool
- **Customer Tier:** Available to J.P. Morgan's institutional and wealth management clients
- **Geography/Languages:** Global (launched by J.P. Morgan Asset Management); available in English initially
- **Core AI Stack:** OpenAI's GPT-4 model for keyword generation, combined with a proprietary Natural Language Processing (NLP) model that scans news articles to identify companies involved in a given theme
- **Description:** IndexGPT creates thematic investment baskets by generating a list of keywords associated with a particular theme. These keywords are then analyzed using a natural language processing model that scans news articles to identify companies involved in that space. Unlike traditional indexes based on industry sectors or company fundamentals, IndexGPT identifies investments based on emerging trends using AI-generated keywords extracted from news articles. The tool allows for the selection of a broader range of stocks, going beyond the obvious choices that are already well-known.
- **Safety & Compliance:** Built within JPMorgan's controlled environment; proprietary data is not used to train the model. The bank has protocols restricting employees from using consumer AI chatbots, and IndexGPT was developed internally with the bank's data security protocols.
- **Integrations:** Part of J.P. Morgan's broader index offering; integrates with the bank's existing investment platforms
- **Access/Pricing:** Available to J.P. Morgan clients; specific pricing not publicly disclosed
- **KPIs:** According to Rui Fernandes, J.P. Morgan's head of markets trading structuring, IndexGPT is seen as "a first step in a long-term process of integrating AI across the bank's index offering." Thematic investing gained popularity in 2020-2021 but waned due to poor performance and higher interest rates; IndexGPT aims to reignite interest by providing a more accurate approach.
- **Executive Quote:** "IndexGPT creates these thematic indexes by generating a list of keywords associated with a particular theme that are then analyzed using a natural language processing model that scans news articles to identify companies involved in that space" — Rui Fernandes, J.P. ### 1. RBC Royal Bank

**NOMI (AI-powered personal finance suite)**
- **Launch:** NOMI was launched in 2017 (pre-dates the 2023–2026 timeframe for *new* launches, but the suite has been continuously expanded during the 2023–2026 period with new features).
- **Description:** RBC launched AI-powered personal finance services called NOMI (a play on "know me"), powered by Personetics Cognitive Banking applications. These services are built directly into RBC's existing mobile app, giving all RBC customers access. [6]
- **Features:**
  - **NOMI Insights:** Provides personalized, timely tips to help customers manage day-to-day finances. It offers daily insights into spending patterns, identifies unusual transactions, issues automatic reminders based on past activity, and predicts potential issues. Unlike US bank alerts which require manual setup, RBC's alerts are generated automatically. The system learns as it interacts with users, becoming more accurate over time. Over 2 billion insights delivered since 2017. [8]
  - **NOMI Find & Save:** An automated savings program. Based on predictive analysis of individual behavior and spending patterns, it determines the minimum cash needed in checking for monthly expenses and automatically transfers excess cash to an interest-bearing savings account. The auto-save can be suspended at any time, and money can be moved back to checking. Customers have saved over $1.9 billion (average $415/month or ~$5,000/year). [8]
  - **NOMI Budget:** Suggests customized budgets based on spending habits; over 2 million budgets suggested since 2019. [8]
  - **NOMI Forecast** (newest addition): Uses ML/AI to provide 7-day cash-flow forecasts based on preauthorized payment withdrawals, helping customers avoid overdrafts and manage short-term finances. Uses technology from Borealis AI, RBC's research center. [8]
  - **Ask NOMI:** Multilingual chatbot that has responded to 4 million text and voice inquiries. [8]
- **Customer tier:** All RBC personal banking customers (mass market). NOMI now serves 12.8 million personal banking customers and has about 1.5 million active users. [8]
- **Geography/Languages:** Canada, multilingual (Ask NOMI supports multiple languages). [8]
- **Core AI stack:** Powered by Personetics Cognitive Banking applications; NOMI Forecast uses technology from Borealis AI (RBC's research center). [8] RBC also developed a proprietary AI foundation model for financial services called **ATOM**, trained on asynchronous event sequences (transactions, client interactions) to enable personalized banking solutions. [7]
- **Safety & Compliance:** RBC's Responsible AI principles: Privacy & Security, Accountability, Fairness, and Transparency & Responsible Disclosure. [10]
- **Integrations:** Built into RBC's existing mobile app. [6]
- **Access/Pricing:** Available to all RBC customers within the mobile app; no additional cost. [6]
- **KPIs:**
  - 53% of NOMI users say it's a game changer for their finances. [8]
  - Customer attrition among NOMI users is less than 1%. [8]
  - Average visit time on the RBC mobile app has more than doubled from 3.5 minutes to 7.5 minutes since NOMI launched. [8]
  - One in nine Canadians had access to NOMI features on their phones within weeks of launch. [6]
  - RBC ranks #1 in Canada and #3 globally for AI maturity in financial services (fourth straight year, per Evident AI Index). [7]

**RBC Borealis (AI research & platform team)**
- RBC Borealis is RBC's AI research and data platform team, comprising architects, engineers, scientists, and product experts focused on revolutionizing finance through AI research, solutions, and a resilient data platform. [7]
- **Lumina:** RBC's internal enterprise data and AI platform for engineers, data scientists, and business analysts. [7]
